:::{#thm-weibull-log-linear}
#### The Weibull model is a log-linear model for event times

Suppose subject $i$ has the Weibull proportional hazards survival function
$\surv_i(t) = \expf{-\theta_i (\lambda t)^p}$ of @thm-weibull-ph-aft,
with $\theta_i \eqdef \expf{\eta_i}$ for a linear predictor $\eta_i$.
Define $\alpha \eqdef -\logf{\lambda}$ and $\sigma \eqdef 1/p$,
and let $W$ have the standard (minimum) Gumbel distribution,
$\P(W > w) = \expf{-\ef{w}}$.
Then the log event time $Y_i \eqdef \logf{T_i}$ has the same distribution as

$$
\alpha - \sigma \eta_i + \sigma W.
$$ {#eq-weibull-log-linear}

:::
